decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposed conversion from an 8-bedroom HMO to four flats is considered unacceptable as no replacement HMO floorspace has been provided as part of the application. No evidence has been provided to demonstrate that the HMO facility does not meet the appropriate standards for an HMO and has no realistic prospect of meeting the standards. The proposal is therefore contrary to policy LP29 of the local plan and policy H9 of the London Plan as such facilities are considered to meet a specific need for low-cost accommodation in the Borough and such a loss is considered detrimental to the housing stock in the Borough. The proposal also fails to accord with policy LP26 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023), as two one-person one-bedroom units are proposed.

Reason : 2 - The development fails to provide an adequate standard of accommodation for future occupiers, as the GIA of flats 2 and 4 fall short of the minimum GIA requirements of the Nationally Described Space Standard (2015), and as the ceiling heights of flat 4 would be under 2.3m for the entire GIA, failing to meet requirements of the Nationally Described Space Standard (2015). Two of the ground floor bedrooms in Flat 1 would also be provided limited outlook as the ground floor lightwell would be insufficient in depth. The proposal therefore fails to comply with the Nationally Described Space Standards and policy LP27 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).

Reason : 3 - The proposed extension to the main rear roof and extension above the back addition, due to their height, steeply sloped rear and side elevations, would appear bulky and would fail to relate appropriately to the host property. The proposed roof terrace, lacking a setback from the sides of the two-storey back addition and with a 0.5m brick enclosure surrounding, would also not appear as a well-integrated addition to the rear of the host building and fail to relate appropriately to the surrounding area and local spatial character. The proposed lowering of the ground and first floor front windows by the extent proposed would give the host property a disjointed appearance and would upset the uniformity of the terrace. The proposal therefore fails to comply with policies LP1 and LP5 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023), and the Wandsworth Housing SPD (2016).

Reason : 4 - The proposed rear roof extension and extension above the back addition would appear overbearing for neighbouring residents, and the extension above the back addition would result in a loss of daylight for the first-floor rear window at the neighbouring property and it has not been demonstrated that this would remain within acceptable parameters.  The proposed roof terrace, due to its siting, would be an unneighbourly form of development that would result in an increase in noise and disturbance for the residents of the neighbouring properties. The proposal therefore fails to accord with policy LP2 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) and the guidance of the Wandsworth Housing SPD (2016).

Reason : 5 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to make available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the principle of the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
description: Alterations including erection of single-storey side/rear extension and mansard roof extension to main rear roof slope including an increase in ridge height (with French doors and safety balustrade) and extension above two-storey back addition.  Replacement of first floor rear window with French doors and safety balustrade. Increase of eaves height of two storey rear extension to form a flat roof and formation of second floor roof terrace with frosted glass balustrade above. Alterations to window locations at front. Extensions and alterations in connection with change of use from large HMO (Sui Generis) into residential (Class C3) consistng 1x 3 bedroom, 1 x 2 bedroom and 2 x 1 bedroom flats. Provision of waste storage.
